text:
You need a SAS developer who can turn data into reliable reports, apply analytical methods rigorously, and document the work clearly for a contract role that may grow into a full-time position.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in building data and AI solutions with Python, machine learning, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, and Hugging Face Transformers. While my background is in Python-based analytics rather than SAS specifically, I’ve worked on projects that required careful data handling, strong analytical thinking, and production-quality documentation—skills that align well with the responsibilities in your post.

One relevant project was a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. That project relied on semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, and it achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, while reducing clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. It required structured data access, precise output, and clear traceability—important qualities for analytical reporting and documentation work.

I also built a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. It was a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with the full context. In that project, 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent, and CSAT reached 4.4 out of 5. That experience strengthened my ability to work with automated routines, business-facing workflows, and systems that need dependable outputs under real operational constraints.

For your SAS role, I would bring the same disciplined approach to data preparation, exploratory analysis, reporting logic, and documentation. I’m comfortable working through ambiguous data problems, translating findings into clear recommendations, and collaborating closely to ensure deliverables are professional and usable. I also value structured communication and would make sure the methodology behind the work is easy to review and maintain.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss how my analytics background can support your SAS implementation and reporting needs.
